about: Held-out intent probe v5. Written on 2026-10-25 AFTER the intent rules were frozen in commit e556127 and committed before it was scored. Scored once; not used for tuning. This is the held-out figure for the submitted rule layer. New shapes beyond v2-v4: informal and all-caps text, polite questions in four languages, removals of things other than the account (wishlist, cart, a charge), status questions, someone else's account, and a reversal after an accidental request.
